newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Japan to cut debt interest to 2.5-3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Japan to cut debt interest to 2.5-3 pct.

text.p: Japan will reduce the interest rates on the $1.757 billion debt owed by Peru to between 2.5 percent and three percent annually, state news agency Andina said on Saturday.

Andina, quoting Peruvian Economy Minister Jorge Camet, said the agreement on interest rates was fixed in a bilateral accord under the umbrella of the government's continuing negotiations with the 14 members of the Paris Club of creditors.
Peru reached a preliminary restructuring agreement with the Paris Club in July.
Andina said Peru had already begun bilateral negotiations with Spain under the Paris Club accord, and would start talks with the United Kingdom in the week ahead.
